editorial:
Imagine being a popular cheerleader who lives for likes and followers, only to wake up in a nightmare. You are trapped in a room with a creepy masked man who thinks he is a god. To survive, you have to do these awful social media challenges that are way more dangerous than any dance trend. It is a wild ride that looks at how obsessed we are with our phones and how far people will go for attention. The vibe is tense and scary, making you feel the panic of the characters as they try to figure out how to get out alive.

The acting is surprisingly good and keeps you on edge throughout the whole thing. While some of the plot points are a bit predictable, the twists keep the story moving fast. If you like movies where people are put in impossible situations, you will love this.
endingExplained: At the end, you find out the kidnapper is actually obsessed with the main girl and wants to mold her into a version of himself. He does not just want to torture her; he wants her to become a monster. After a big fight, she manages to outsmart him by using the same social media tools he used to trap her. She eventually kills the masked man and escapes, but she is forever changed by the horror.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves survival games and creepy villains.
